digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center backend comment sanitization
propositions: rebar hardcodes comment truncation at 32767 characters, matching the default of Jira DC's admin-configurable jira.text.field.character.limit property
when a DC administrator raises or removes the text field character limit, rebar silently truncates comments that would be accepted by the instance, causing permanent local/remote divergence
the comment sanitizer incorrectly couples to the description fitter, risking future changes to description fitting logic from inadvertently retargeting comment limits
the DC comment ceiling must be made configurable with a default of 32767, with configurability validated by a red-first unit test covering raised and lowered ceiling scenarios
discovery of the live limit via /rest/api/2/application-properties is not viable for ordinary-user PATs and must be dropped, leaving configuration as the sole remedy
